measurement.platform: native linux/amd64 on Deckbox (AMD Ryzen 9 7900, Docker Engine 29.1.3, cgroup v2)
measurement.q: geometric mean over the frozen corpus files of the per-file candidate/reference speed ratio for combined UTF-8 validation + UTF-8->UTF-16LE transcoding; each file ratio is a min-of-N estimator (min candidate wall over N alternating reps / min reference wall), the contention-robust choice for ~1s legs under the shared Docker VM's persistent background contention (the differential load a within-pair geomean cannot cancel); wall measured in the trusted evaluator parent around a runner that dlopens the candidate ONLY after control-channel auth and reports no timing; the reference library is built from frozen trusted sources and timed adjacently; never a self-reported number from candidate-linked code. Timed iterations are byte-distinct: the trusted runner rewrites a sparse rotating subset of code points to same-length valid code points before every iteration after the first, and folds every iteration's verdict+transcoded bytes into a go-time-nonce-bound digest validated against the reference. The reject path is exercised ON the scored path: on a go-nonce-scheduled subset of timed iterations (~1/8, plus one forced iteration per leg) the trusted runner writes a genuinely invalid UTF-8 unit (lone continuation / overlong form / surrogate in a three-byte slot / truncated multibyte) at a nonce-chosen code point and restores it afterwards; the reference deterministically rejects those iterations (verdict=0, zero units) and the verdict byte is captured by the fold, so a driver that skips validation or converts without validating diverges from the reference digest.
measurement.equalCoreBudget: every measured launch (reference and candidate legs alike) is clamped to the same single fixed CPU by the per-launch cgroup leaf's cpuset.cpus (kernel-owned; the demoted uid cannot write the control file and sched_setaffinity from inside is clamped to the cpuset), so a thread-parallel candidate cannot buy wall-clock throughput with cores the single-threaded reference never uses; preexec sched_setaffinity is the non-cgroup developer fallback
measurement.peakRssGate: candidate whole-tree peak RSS <= per-split frozen baseline (protected asset) * 1.05, measured as the kernel-owned cgroup2 memory.peak of a fresh per-launch leaf the candidate subtree joins before the privilege drop; the baseline is frozen near the observed whole-tree baseline peak (max over all launches of a full baseline eval, plus a small cross-run noise margin) so the gate binds against the true baseline on both splits
measurement.validationOracle: the in-eval trusted reference (built from sealed trusted sources, never candidate-linked) is the pristine payload + perturbed-digest oracle; the malformed probe corpus is synthesized PER RUN by the trusted parent from fresh randomness (kind-rotated invalid units embedded in random valid UTF-8, strict-decode-asserted invalid; never shipped as fixed fixtures, so unenumerable and disjoint across runs and splits); each candidate launch runs in a fresh SysV-IPC namespace and candidate-writable residue (/tmp, /var/tmp, /dev/shm, SysV IPC) is purged between launches

normalization.status: final native linux/amd64 rebaseline from five A-A samples under the accepted frozen evaluator contract
